_comment: Canonical sample feed for UI mockups. Fields mirror the real FeedItem model (bill, policy_area, digest{headline,what_it_does,key_points,terms_explained}, raw_summary_text, passage_votes[], latest_passage_date) PLUS exploratory fields the redesign may want: affects[] (groups touched), impact (one-line 'what changes for a person'), margin + marginLabel (close-vote signal). Inline this data into each mockup so files open via file://.

bill.title: A bill to cap monthly out-of-pocket insulin costs and require Medicare price negotiation for high-cost drugs.

feed.impact: If you use insulin, your monthly cost would be capped at $35 starting next year.

digest.headline: Senate caps insulin at $35 a month for most insured patients
digest.what_it_does: Limits what insured patients pay for insulin to $35 per month and directs Medicare to negotiate prices on a list of the most expensive drugs. Costs above the cap are absorbed by insurers and manufacturers rather than patients.
key_points: Caps insulin out-of-pocket cost at $35/month for people with insurance
Requires Medicare to negotiate prices on the 20 highest-cost drugs
Penalizes manufacturers that raise prices faster than inflation

terms_explained.plain: The amount you pay yourself, after insurance pays its share.
The government bargaining directly with drug makers to lower the price it pays.

feed.raw_summary_text: This Act caps cost-sharing for a covered insulin product at $35 per month for plan years beginning on or after January 1, 2027. It further directs the Secretary to identify negotiation-eligible drugs and to publish maximum fair prices. Manufacturers exceeding the inflation benchmark are subject to rebates payable to the Treasury.

bill.title: To authorize additional border security personnel, technology, and asylum processing capacity.

feed.impact: Adds funding for faster asylum decisions and more border staff; no direct change to your taxes.

digest.headline: House narrowly funds more border agents and faster asylum processing
digest.what_it_does: Authorizes hiring thousands of additional border and asylum officers, funds surveillance technology, and sets deadlines for processing asylum claims. It does not change who qualifies for asylum.
key_points: Funds ~5,000 new border and asylum personnel
Sets a 180-day target to decide asylum claims
Adds sensor and camera technology along the southern border

terms_explained.plain: Protection given to people who can't safely return to their home country.

feed.raw_summary_text: This bill authorizes appropriations for U.S. Customs and Border Protection to increase staffing levels and deploy detection technology. It establishes adjudication timelines for credible-fear and asylum determinations and requires quarterly reporting to Congress.

bill.title: To expand telehealth access for veterans in rural areas.

feed.impact: If you're a veteran far from a VA clinic, more visits could happen by video.

digest.headline: Veterans gain permanent telehealth access in a near-unanimous vote
digest.what_it_does: Makes permanent the VA's authority to provide care by video and phone across state lines, and funds broadband stipends for veterans in rural areas.
key_points: Funds connectivity stipends for rural veterans
Requires the VA to report on wait times

terms_explained.plain: Seeing a doctor by video or phone instead of in person.

feed.raw_summary_text: This Act permanently authorizes the Department of Veterans Affairs to furnish hospital care and medical services through telehealth regardless of the locations of the provider or veteran, and authorizes a grant program for connectivity.

bill.title: To reduce interest rates on federal student loans and pause accrual during hardship.

feed.impact: This one failed — federal student loan interest rules stay as they are for now.

digest.headline: Student-loan interest relief falls two votes short in the Senate
digest.what_it_does: Would have lowered interest rates on new federal student loans and paused interest during documented financial hardship. The measure did not pass.
key_points: Proposed lower fixed rates on new federal loans
Would pause interest accrual during hardship deferment

terms_explained.plain: Interest piling up on what you owe, even while payments are paused.

feed.raw_summary_text: This bill would have amended the Higher Education Act to reduce interest rates and suspend interest accrual during periods of qualifying economic hardship. The motion failed to achieve passage.

bill.title: Making supplemental appropriations for disaster recovery and rebuilding.

feed.impact: Releases rebuilding money to recent disaster areas; helps if your county was federally declared.

digest.headline: House approves $24B in disaster recovery funding
digest.what_it_does: Provides supplemental funding for FEMA disaster relief, low-interest rebuilding loans, and grants to states recovering from recent hurricanes and wildfires.
key_points: Expands low-interest rebuilding loans for homeowners
Sends block grants to hard-hit states

terms_explained.plain: Extra money approved outside the normal yearly budget.

feed.raw_summary_text: This Act makes supplemental appropriations for the Disaster Relief Fund and authorizes the Small Business Administration to issue disaster loans. Funds remain available until expended.
